description.description: A series of frames from a video showing a nighttime street protest or celebration labeled with "VENEZUELA LIBRE" and a Venezuelan flag emoji. In the frames, a large crowd of people is gathered on a city street at night. Many people are waving Venezuelan flags. There is a line of cars moving slowly through the crowd on the left side of the frame, with people leaning out of windows or standing near the vehicles. The atmosphere appears to be one of high energy, with individuals running and cheering in the street. A TikTok watermark for the user @coolkiw8w is visible in the bottom right corner of each frame.
